outcome: Neonatal acidosis (umbilical artery pH ≤ 7.1 or base excess ≤ -12 mmol)
cohort: 332 individuals undergoing scheduled CD, with 330 (99.4%) receiving prophylactic vasopressors
finding: Sustained hypotension after spinal anesthesia, despite prophylactic vasopressor use, was associated with an increased risk of neonatal acidosis but not with other adverse perinatal outcomes.
